daily_feed.dedup: same canonical URL -> one card; same normalized headline (GOV.UK document-type prefixes kept, so 'Guidance: X' and 'Consultation outcome: X' stay distinct) within 3 days -> one card. A card already shown keeps its id (read state); otherwise the earliest wins. Other publishers go to also_reported_by; every merged copy, same publisher included, is recorded in the payload's duplicates ledger.
